jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)

Confidential Executive Search

A global enterprise software company is seeking a Chief Information Security Officer to lead its security, risk management, product security, and corporate IT functions.
This role combines executive leadership with deep technical judgment. You will protect sensitive customer and business data, strengthen security across cloud-based products, and help teams adopt Generative AI safely and effectively.
We are looking for a security leader who partners closely with engineering and business teams, translates risk into clear business decisions, and builds practical controls that support innovation.
What you’ll lead

Secure GenAI adoption:
Partner across engineering and business functions to enable commercial and open-source AI tools. Establish guardrails for sensitive data, intellectual property, access, and third-party AI services.
Product and application security:
Embed threat modeling, secure development practices, and automated security testing into the software development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines. Oversee API security, penetration testing, and remediation across production applications.
AI security and governance:
Address risks including data leakage, adversarial attacks, and model exploitation. Develop governance aligned with relevant AI frameworks and regulatory requirements.
Third-party risk management:
Establish security assessment standards, vendor risk scoring, and ongoing monitoring for software providers, service partners, and contractors.
Corporate IT and infrastructure:
Lead global IT operations, endpoint and network security, business applications, and infrastructure resilience. Own business continuity and disaster recovery planning for corporate IT.
Executive and board engagement:
Communicate security priorities, emerging risks, investment needs, and progress to senior leadership and the board. Support enterprise customer security discussions.

What you’ll bring

12+ years of progressive cybersecurity and risk management experience, including at least five years in a CISO, CSO, VP of Security, or equivalent executive leadership role within B2B SaaS, fintech, or AI technology.
Demonstrated accountability for both security teams and corporate IT or infrastructure operations.
A strong record of leading application security, DevSecOps, and secure software development for cloud-based products operating at scale.
Practical experience enabling GenAI or LLM adoption through security architecture, governance, and operational controls.
Experience building and managing third-party risk management programs.
Strong knowledge of AWS and/or GCP environments, zero-trust architecture, NIST, ISO 27001, SOC standards, and OWASP guidance, including security risks associated with LLM applications.
Experience advising executives, presenting to boards or board committees, and engaging enterprise customers.
CISSP or CISM certification.
A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

AI governance or secure software lifecycle credentials, such as AIGP or CSSLP, are additional advantages.
Compensation and working arrangements

The role offers an executive compensation package comprising base salary, bonus, and equity, with remote-first working arrangements.
About the search

This is a confidential executive search. Company details and further information about the opportunity will be shared during initial recruiter discussions.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Cybersecurity, Metrics & Reporting - Remote
jobs.description:
Preference will be given to candidates residing in the Eastern or Central time zones.

As a Senior Manager, Cybersecurity, Metrics and Reporting, you will lead the enterprise strategy, governance, and execution of cybersecurity performance measurement, analytics, and reporting. You will partner with senior leaders across Cybersecurity, Technology, Risk, Audit, Compliance, and business functions to provide clear visibility into cyber risk, program effectiveness, operational performance, resilience, and investment outcomes.

What you will do:

Define, implement, and continuously evolve the enterprise cybersecurity metrics, reporting, and analytics strategy in alignment with organizational objectives and cyber risk priorities.
Serve as the enterprise leader for cybersecurity measurement and reporting, translating data-driven analysis into strategic insights and recommendations for senior leadership.
Influence cybersecurity strategy, investment prioritization, and enterprise risk management decisions through advanced analytics and performance reporting.
Establish reporting maturity roadmaps and continuous improvement programs that advance enterprise cybersecurity measurement capabilities.

Technical Responsibilities:

Establish and govern cybersecurity key performance indicators, key risk indicators, performance measures, metric definitions, data quality standards, reporting controls, and lifecycle management practices.
Lead the development and delivery of executive, board, audit committee, and regulatory reporting on cybersecurity risk, performance, resilience, and program effectiveness.
Measure cybersecurity control effectiveness, operational performance, cyber resilience, risk reduction outcomes, and returns on cybersecurity investments.
Analyze performance trends, emerging threats, risk indicators, and outcomes to identify improvement opportunities and recommend mitigation strategies.
Lead initiatives that automate cybersecurity reporting and expand dashboard, data visualization, predictive analytics, risk forecasting, telemetry-driven automation, and AI-enabled analytics capabilities.
Integrate and govern cybersecurity telemetry from enterprise security platforms, cloud environments, identity systems, and emerging AI security capabilities to support automated reporting, advanced analytics, and operational decisions.

Leadership & People Management Responsibilities:

Lead teams, programs, and enterprise initiatives responsible for cybersecurity metrics, analytics, governance, and reporting.
Guide cross-functional initiatives and align cybersecurity, technology, risk, audit, compliance, and business stakeholders around enterprise measurement priorities.

Knowledge and Capabilities:

Synthesize complex cybersecurity, risk, and performance information into concise executive, board, audit committee, and regulatory communications.
Apply analytical and quantitative reasoning to cybersecurity measurement, risk analytics, business intelligence, and performance reporting.
Prioritize concurrent reporting, analytics, and strategic initiatives while meeting established deadlines.

What You Need:

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related discipline.
Minimum 10 years of experience in information technology, cybersecurity, or product security.
Minimum 8 years of experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, business intelligence, data analytics, or performance reporting.
Experience developing and governing enterprise cybersecurity metrics, key performance indicators, key risk indicators, and performance measurement frameworks.
Experience delivering executive, board, or regulatory reporting that supports strategic decision-making.
Leadership experience managing teams, programs, or enterprise initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Power BI, Tableau, ServiceNow, Archer, or equivalent data visualization and reporting platforms.
CISSP, CRISC, CISM, Security+, Certified Data Analyst, or equivalent certification.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Cybersecurity, CTEM & Vulnerability Intelligence - Remote
jobs.description:
Preference will be given to candidates residing in the Eastern or Central time zones.

As a Senior Manager, CTEM & Vulnerability Management, you will lead the enterprise Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) and Vulnerability Management function across enterprise IT, cloud, operational technology (OT), and product environments. You will partner with Product Security, Threat Intelligence, Security Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, and Engineering teams to reduce exposure through risk-based discovery, prioritization, validation, and remediation.

What you will do:

Technical Responsibilities:

Lead the enterprise CTEM and Vulnerability Management program, including its strategy, roadmap, and operating model.
Oversee vulnerability scanning and assessment across infrastructure, cloud, endpoint, application, identity, network, and OT environments.
Manage the product security vulnerability lifecycle with Product Security, including intake, triage, risk assessment, remediation tracking, software bill of materials (SBOM) analysis, and coordinated vulnerability disclosure support.
Prioritize vulnerabilities and exposures using CVSS, EPSS, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV), threat intelligence, asset criticality, and business context.
Lead attack surface management, exposure validation, and breach and attack simulation activities to confirm exploitability and control effectiveness.
Evaluate emerging vulnerabilities, exploits, and threat intelligence affecting enterprise systems, marketed products, and embedded systems.
Drive automation for vulnerability discovery, data enrichment, ticketing, remediation workflows, and reporting through SOAR platforms, APIs, Python, or PowerShell.
Support cyber incident investigations with vulnerability context, exposure analysis, and remediation expertise.

Leadership & People Management Responsibilities:

Partner with Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, Product Security, and Engineering teams to establish risk-based service-level agreements, drive remediation, and track plans of action and milestones.
Establish governance standards, quality assurance procedures, and documentation for vulnerability and exposure management operations.
Measure and report exposure reduction, remediation performance, validation results, and operational metrics to executive stakeholders.
Lead vulnerability management, exposure management, or product security vulnerability teams.

Knowledge and Capabilities:

Analyze complex vulnerability data and large volumes of exposure telemetry to identify risk and guide response.
Translate technical findings, remediation status, and risk trends into clear written, verbal, and presentation-ready updates for technical and executive audiences.

What You Need:

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
Minimum 10 years of experience in cybersecurity.
Minimum 3 years of experience leading vulnerability management, exposure management, or product security vulnerability teams.
Experience managing product vulnerabilities, including triage, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, SBOM analysis, and remediation with product engineering teams.
Experience with Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Wiz, ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, or equivalent vulnerability and exposure management technologies.
Experience implementing automation through SOAR platforms, APIs, Python, or PowerShell.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
CISSP, CISM, GEVA, GPEN, GIAC, Tenable, Qualys, or equivalent professional certification.

jobs.title: Director of IT, Enterprise Architecture
jobs.description:
A position at White Cap isn’t your ordinary job. You’ll work in an exciting and diverse environment, meet interesting people, and have a variety of career opportunities.

The White Cap family is committed to Building Trust on Every Job. We do this by being deeply knowledgeable, fully capable, and always dependable, and our associates are the driving force behind this commitment.

Job Summary

Lead and manage teams of IT associates. Effectively influences others to accomplish the mission of the organization. Define the work environment and provide the framework to support teams. Identify priorities as well as provide the direction for completing tasks on time. Accountable for the bottom-line results of the team.

Major Tasks, Responsibilities, And Key Accountabilities

Develops IT plans in support of specific business objectives.
Manages business relationships and monitors status of business.
Manages and coordinates strategic activities for staff. Monitors completion per the governance process.
Defines requirements and design for IT projects in support of key business objectives.
Ensures business and IT strategic alignment.
Oversees the management and resolution of IT customer service issues.

Nature and Scope

Problems are typically defined by higher level leadership. Problems are difficult. Solutions require analysis and investigation.
Decides how to achieve planned results within an organization's plans, policies, and guidelines. May set or change plans/goals within respective department or area.
May manage department via multiple layers of managers OR directly supervise a staff of professional individual contributors at the senior or technical advisor level.

Work Environment

Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.
Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles.
Typically requires overnight travel less than 10% of the time.

Education And Experience

Typically requires BS/BA in a related discipline. Generally 9+ years of experience in a related field, including several years in a management/supervisory capacity.

Preferred Qualifications

12+ years of progressive IT experience, including 5+ years in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, Technology Strategy, or related leadership roles.
3+ years leading architecture teams, governance functions, or cross-functional technology organizations at the Director or Senior Management level.
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
Proven success developing enterprise technology strategies, target-state architectures, business cases, and multi-year roadmaps that align technology investments with business objectives.
Deep understanding of enterprise architecture disciplines including business, application, data, infrastructure, security, integration, cloud, and AI architecture, with knowledge of frameworks such as TOGAF, BIZBOK, ArchiMate, COBIT, NIST, or similar methodologies.
Experience establishing and leading architecture governance programs, including principles, standards, guardrails, reference architectures, technology portfolio governance, architectural compliance, and exception management.
Strong knowledge in Microsoft Azure cloud platforms, enterprise integration architectures, APIs, event-driven solutions, and hybrid-cloud environments.
Experience architecting modern data, analytics, and AI platforms, including data governance, AI governance, automation, machine learning, and responsible AI adoption.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale business and technology transformation initiatives, including cloud modernization, enterprise platforms, cybersecurity, data modernization, AI enablement, and digital transformation.
Strong ability to influence executives, business leaders, and technology teams in a matrixed environment while driving alignment and adoption of enterprise standards.
Exceptional executive communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value.

If you’re looking to play a role in building America, consider one of our open opportunities. We can’t wait to meet you.

jobs.title: Senior Cybersecurity Engagement Coordination Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Summary:

Job Responsibilities

Lafayette Group is seeking qualified and team-oriented individuals to work with federal government organizations in support of national cybersecurity programs. We are seeking an experienced Senior Cybersecurity Engagement Coordination Manager, to support the acceleration of information sharing across priority intelligence communities. A successful candidate is an empathetic communicator and relationship builder who takes a service-oriented approach to supporting the program team and an adaptable problem solver with the ability to deal with multi-dimensional challenges. The ideal candidate for this role is an experienced, collaborative team member who shares our passion for supporting cybersecurity, has an innate curiosity to learn, and the drive to excel with a team of like-minded colleagues in a dynamic environment. This position will:

The Senior Cybersecurity Engagement Coordination Manager Will

Provide tailored recommendations as a trusted advisor for clients to address evolving programs and processes.
Facilitate collaborative working sessions with external stakeholders to ensure that product recommendations align with their existing operational processes, compliance requirements, and resource limitations.
Coordinate targeted engagement to deliver cyber products to priority communities.
Interpret cybersecurity topics to effectively tailor oral and written communications for various and specific stakeholders (Executives, SOC, etc.).
Collect and analyze qualitative and quantitative performance data indicators to report on key metrics.
Support a team in the translation of strategic products into clear, practical formats tailored to the specific needs and operational constraints of stakeholder groups

Required Skills

Active TS security clearance and SCI eligible
US citizenship with an ability to obtain and maintain DHS Suitability (EOD)
Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, information technology, business analysis, management, or similar field.
8+ years of experience in cybersecurity or related field, specifically in translating high-level strategy into tangible, actionable products.
Ability to maintain broader situational awareness beyond the immediate team
Strong background in stakeholder engagement and relationship management, with a record of successfully collaborating with diverse stakeholders.
Experience facilitating meetings, workshops, or cross sector working groups.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Desired Skills

Experience consulting or advisory role, providing guidance and recommendations to external organizations.
Knowledge of different communication channels and outreach strategies, including social media, webinars, and partner portals.
Familiarity with the operations and mission of CISA, JCDC, or other federal cybersecurity organizations, incidents, events, and vulnerabilities for situational awareness.
Knowledge of critical infrastructure sectors, public-private partnerships, and cyber defense missions.

Location:
On site, 5 days per week Arlington, VA

Salary Range
: $110,000 - $140,000

LGI carefully considers various factors when determining salary, including but not limited to education and training, professional experience, knowledge, skills and competencies, licensure and certifications, contract-specific affordability, and organizational requirements. New employees are not usually hired at the top of the estimated salary range and salary decisions depend on the circumstances and factors for each case. Salary is only one aspect of LGI’s generous total compensation package.

Federal Contracts:
This position involves working on federal contracts that require all workers on the contract to be U.S. Citizens. Additionally, some contracts may require the ability to obtain a security clearance.

LGI is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, we will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact talent@lafayettegroup.com .

Lafayette Group provides equal employment opportunities to all persons and prohibits employment decisions based on race, religion, color, creed, national origin, sex, age, disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, or sexual orientation.
